name: find-the-human
description: 실시간 역튜링 테스트 게임 인간을 찾아라

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:e2e
